name: Shaker base cabinet with quartz top
notes: Width knob 0.3-1.2 m for runs; countertop knob (3 cm stone.quartz, eased 3 mm, 2.5 cm overhang); sinkCutout knob cuts the top for an undermount sink and turns the drawer into a tilt-out false front. parts: painted shaker drawer front over two shaker doors (one door under 0.6 m)
plywood box with adjustable shelf and dovetail drawer box
3 cm quartz countertop with eased edges and 2.5 cm front overhang
style: transitional painted kitchen, satin white or sage tint knob
summary: Shaker base cabinet, 90 cm: painted drawer over two doors, nickel bar pulls, plywood box and shelf, 3 cm quartz top.
